title: Ñu dàq ci asamaan si
intro: Amna mbindéef bu yéeme bu taxaw ci wetu mbindéef ak bañ. Seen jaar-jaar dafa ànd ak réy-réy gu amul fenn, ba noppi ñu baña déggal ndigalu Yàlla. Seenug tànneef mingi wéy ci jamono bu nekk, di nekk natt ci bépp ruuh bu judd ci àdduna bi. Ndax mën nga ràññee noon budul jeex bii?
clues: Maa ngi woon ci xew-xew bu am solo ci àdduna, bi ñu defaree mbindéef bu bees ci ban, mu am dundu ci Noyyig Boroom Yërmaande bi.
Man ci sama bopp maa ngi juddoo ci benn mbindéef buy tàkk, te wuute na ak mbindéef pënd mi.
Dañu ma jox benn ndigal buma jàpp ni mingi ci suufu sama gaaraas.
Ma gëna réy, ba noppi ma baña déggal ndigal googu.
Ñu may ma yeexal ba bis biñ ma jàpp, suko defee ma mëna topp sama mébet bima waxoon, di réerloo ñeneen ñi.
Man maay noonu ñépp ñiy dox ci kaw suuf, di leen gëmloo, di leen nax ñu génn ci yoonu jub wi.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. (16:99)
